_comment: Scripted hermetic delivery/tracker responses for a replayed /wf:verify-spec round. Per the wf-fake contract (capabilities/fake/fragments/tracker.ops.md): a JSON-array value is an ordered sequence indexed by prior calls to the same (surface, op) pair; a scalar/object is returned on every call. The audit itself reads the seeded working tree directly; the delivery reads here only identify the branch, the head, and the changed-file set the round's own header recorded. kit/materialize-round.sh rewrites current-branch-query, last-commit-timestamp-query and branch-changes-read per round into generated/fake-scripts.<task>-r<NN>.json; this file is the shape those are generated from. **Model:** claude-fable-5-1

get.title: Offer one explicit user gate when the revision cap is hit with blocking findings left
get.description: The replayed task's own requirements are already present in the seeded task folder (00_reqs.md, 01_spec.md); this record only exists so a read does not fail.
